text: The ER = EPR conjecture (Maldacena and Susskind, 2013) proposes that:
choices: erasing one bit of information requires dissipating a minimum of k_B T ln 2 of heat into the environment
the entanglement entropy of an evaporating black hole follows the Page curve whenever the evolution is unitary
an Einstein-Rosen bridge (wormhole) connecting two entangled black holes is the very same object as the EPR entanglement between them
the wavefunction of the universe satisfies a constraint equation that contains no time parameter
explanation: ER = EPR identifies the geometric wormhole connection (Einstein-Rosen bridge) with quantum entanglement (EPR), implying that spacetime connectivity is constituted by entanglement. The distractors are other genuine results from this unit — Landauer's principle, Page's curve for black-hole radiation, and the Wheeler-DeWitt equation — none of which is what ER = EPR asserts.
